faq.question: What does Norliza mean?
faq.answer: Norliza is associated with the Arabic form نُورْ لِيزَا, whose core sense is norliza; light of liza (malay form).

faq.answer: Norliza is associated with Arabic. Norliza is a Malay compound of Arabic نُور (nūr, 'light') + the name Liza.

faq.question: Is Norliza an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Norliza can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Norliza should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.
